scope: Isolated trial: omit only the implicit local client tag from publication indexes, passing its precomputed position as a StoreLocal argument. HttpStorageInfo layout unchanged; full metadata/tags/generations and native behavior preserved. Client invalidation scans resident HTTP nodes and physically removes literal tag matches; custom/URL indexes retained. Existing13semantics tests unchanged; new2cases cover encoded clients, cross-client explicit matches, selectors, lazy-admin metadata and full byte reclamation. No per-node scan enumerator allocation (Array.IndexOf string equality is ordinal). Correctness only; no speed claim.
